nodes.name: ATS boards (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby)
nodes.notes: Fan out one HTTP node (or a loop over data/watchlist.json) per company board. Documented public JSON APIs — full JD text.

nodes.name: LinkedIn guest jobs (HTML)
nodes.notes: Reverse-engineered guest endpoint. Returns HTML cards → parse in the Normalize Code node. Second call fetches full JD by job-id (enrichment).

filters.q: from:(linkedin.com OR naukri.com OR indeed.com OR iimjobs.com) newer_than:3d

nodes.name: Gmail — job-alert emails
nodes.notes: Native Gmail node replaces the custom IMAP code. Parse title/company from the subject line in the Normalize node.

nodes.name: Normalize + dedupe (Code)
nodes.notes: Paste the same JS used by the app (stripHtml, makeJob, dedupe). This is where reverse-engineered LinkedIn/Shine parsing lives — n8n can't bypass bot-protection, so keep parsing as code.

nodes.name: AI — tailor CV per JD
nodes.notes: Anthropic (or OpenAI) call. Output the tailored CV markdown → convert to .doc/.pdf in a Code node or an external render endpoint.

nodes.name: Persist → Google Sheets / Notion / Postgres
nodes.notes: Native node — swapping the store is a node change, not a code change. This also gives cross-device sync for free.

parameters.subject: =🎯 {{ $items().length }} new matches — top {{ $json.score.total }}% {{ $json.title }} @ {{ $json.company }}
parameters.message: See attached tailored CV drafts + apply links.

meta.description: Importable starter workflow that mirrors JobSearchOS in n8n: cron → parallel source fetch (ATS APIs + LinkedIn + Gmail) → merge/dedupe/score (Code nodes reusing the app's JS) → filter → AI CV tailoring → persist to a DB node → email digest → Slack push for strong matches. Reverse-engineered scraping stays in Code nodes; n8n owns scheduling, fan-out, retries, persistence, and notifications.
